invariants: Hidden tree refs refs/gitcraft/drafts/<worktree-id> protect separate raw index and working trees; no WIP commits or normal-push exposure.
Real index and shared split cache are read-only; private copied cache detects working edits and all recovery index bytes are pinned.
Ignored untracked, nested repositories and submodule contents excluded; changed links/special files/conflicts fail closed.
Empty private Git config, templates, hooks, raw attributes and --no-lazy-fetch block filters/signing/hooks/fsmonitor and implicit downloads.
Selected text hunks and whole binary files recover via guarded native patches; pre-recovery safety draft/Undo preview; index, mode, hardlink peers and unselected edits preserved.
Source generation/cancellation, HEAD/branch/index/raw-file/ref checks and compare-and-swap publication/deletion guard stale state; 50-version/14-day retention.
limitations: Live SSH/WSL not exercised (optional env unset); typed remote read shell/quoting executed locally.
Snapshots require Git with --no-lazy-fetch; older Git fails closed before checkout/rebase when enabled.
Changed symlinks, special files, conflicted indexes and changed gitlinks require manual backup; regular file content recovery only, no mode-only restoration.
UTF-8 portable safe paths required;8MiB/file,32MiB captured content,2000 changed and20000 index paths; snapshot metadata1MiB and index/cache32MiB.
Mirror pushes/manual all-ref exports can include hidden drafts; normal push defaults skip them.
Raw index-layer recovery includes LFS pointers and no line-ending/filter conversion.
Native Git2.52 --attr-source apply segfault avoided using private highest-precedence info/attributes; no-index preview keeps explicit empty attribute source.

review_correction.status: implemented and locally validated; reviewer must independently recheck
changes: Per-request cancellation generation invalidates on modal Cancel/Escape/replacement, profile reload, worktree parking or tab drop.
One running reader plus latest-only pending request; stale callbacks cannot publish.
Read config accepts cancellation; pending jobs retain their initiating immutable Profile context.
Actual underlying remote completion tickets gate new readers after the caller returns. No wall-clock cooldown or new process controls.

remote_completion_proof.ticket_acquired: forecast_spawn synchronously increments scoped pending count BEFORE connections::spawn can run.
remote_completion_proof.ticket_held: Ticket remains alive around the complete remote::exec invocation, including pool/connect waits and result sending.
remote_completion_proof.nested_cleanup: Context::drop uses forecast_spawn; nested forecast_remote workers inherit the same scope and acquire their own tickets.
remote_completion_proof.release: Actual closure return/unwind drops the ticket; no timer substitutes for completion.
remote_completion_proof.reader_gate: State reader_completion.pending() must be false before the latest pending reader can start.
remote_completion_proof.profile_proof: The production completion-aware spawn uses connections::spawn; synthetic parent/child verify the same captured Profile Context without any real SSH key or host.
